location: Tarzana and Woodland Hills, Los Angeles, CA

evidence.description: Entry by smashing open rear sliding glass doors.
Residences ransacked; jewelry, designer purses, glasses and clothing taken.

notes: One record stands for a string of February 2026 burglaries in two neighborhoods; the release gives no count or dates, so the first of the month is used. Items seized later from the suspects include hand-held radios, masks, gloves, Wi-Fi jammers, two vehicles, weapons and ammunition; the release does not tie any item to a specific burglary, so none is recorded as evidence here. Seizure photos are at series level in photos.
